@graph.rdfs:label: Harmoniseerimisseos (Harmonisation link)
@graph.rdfs:comment: A link between an Estonian law and national laws of other EU member states that transpose the same EU directive.

@graph.rdfs:label: harmoniseeritud (harmonised with)
@graph.rdfs:comment: Links an Estonian law to a harmonisation record showing parallel implementations of the same EU directive in other member states.

@graph.rdfs:label: ühine direktiiv (shared directive)
@graph.rdfs:comment: The EU directive that multiple member states have transposed.

@graph.rdfs:label: liikmesriigi kood (member state code)
@graph.rdfs:comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the EU member state.

@graph.rdfs:label: riigisisene CELEX (national CELEX number)
@graph.rdfs:comment: CELEX identifier for the national transposition measure.
